newsitem.title: USA: Carpenter Tech sees lower FY '97 earnings.
newsitem.headline: Carpenter Tech sees lower FY '97 earnings.

text.p: Carpenter Technology Corp Tuesday said it expects fiscal year 1997 earnings, ending June 30, 1997, would be lower than last year's earnings.

Carpenter Chairman, President and Chief executive Robert Cardy, in a statement, cited customer inventory adjustments in some industries and the need to reduce Carpenter's own inventories as the reasons for his current earnings projection.
Last July, Carpenter reported fully diluted fiscal year 1996 earnings of $3.38 per share.
